title: Personal agents are getting their own computers
description: Explores the next evolution of AI agents—moving beyond information retrieval to autonomous action on user behalf. A critical perspective on the future of human-AI interaction and the trust dynamics involved.

title: UX designers are not designing interfaces, they design personalities
description: This essay reframes UX design beyond interface creation to personality and cultural impact, exploring how apps shape our self-understanding. A thought-provoking perspective that challenges designers to consider deeper psychological and cultural implications of their work.

title: Design in the material you ship
description: This practical guide explores how designers should understand code the way architects understand materials, and how AI is transforming the designer-developer relationship. Essential reading for teams looking to bridge the design-to-implementation gap.

title: How to build a brand foundation with AI without losing your craft
description: A practical playbook for leveraging AI tools like Claude to build design systems while maintaining craftsmanship and developer respect. Bridges the gap between AI efficiency and thoughtful design practice.

title: Someone behind the software
description: Karri Saarinen reflects on how the values, experience, and thinking of product makers embed themselves into software design. A deeply human perspective on product craft that resonates with designers seeking authenticity.

title: What if AI sets us free?
description: A philosophical exploration of AI's dual potential to both constrain and liberate humanity, examining how we maintain agency in an AI-driven world. Provocative thinking for designers responsible for shaping AI experiences.

title: Beyond the Canvas
description: Covers emerging trends revealed at Config India 2026, highlighting the expanding possibilities of design beyond traditional digital interfaces. A timely perspective on where design practice is evolving.

title: A thousand days of stale popcorn
description: A narrative-driven exploration of behavioral design and habit formation through everyday examples like gyms and streak counters. Insightful for product managers and designers building engagement-focused experiences.
